interpretation_limits: Six reported executions are one L2-exposed incident.
No unlabelled false-positive or independent recall claim.
No threshold tuning, label-fed worker, hindsight-selected emitter or population restricted to attack hashes.
Historical observation/label-availability and receipt status remain unknown.
Core Withdraw is not a monetary outflow measure; no ABI or loss calculation.
Playback UTC budget and local queue timings are not historical response times.
ordering: Exact chain order (block_number,transaction_index,log_index), not source-report list order.
primary_measure: Count notification_emitted=true rows whose source transaction_hash belongs to the frozen six externally reported executions.
run_policy: Execute unchanged event_log_replay.py and unchanged core parameters once per declared cell; labels are joined only after decisions are closed and hashed.

supporting_measures.pre_first_execution_budget: Count emitted notifications on rows with (block_number,transaction_index) strictly less than the first reported execution, grouped by playback budget_day_utc; report against fixed daily_budget=5.
supporting_measures.reported_execution_counts: For rows belonging to each of six hashes and their union: event count, raw_trigger=true, group_candidate=true, notification_emitted=true, and suppression_reason grouped/budget/below_threshold/duplicate/late.
supporting_measures.whole_day_counts: Same accounting over every selected source log; no negative label is assigned to other transactions.
